car_questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
options: (1) Flashing yellow light.
(2) Traffic control signal.
(3) Crosswalk flashing signal.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Traffic control signal..

car_questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
options: (1) Crosswalk flashing signal.
(2) Special flashing yellow light signal.
(3) Flashing red light signal.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Special flashing yellow light signal..

car_questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
options: (1) Pedestrian-only signal.
(2) Flashing yellow light.
(3) Pedestrian crossing signal.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Pedestrian-only signal..

car_questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
options: (1) Flashing yellow light.
(2) Flashing red light signal.
(3) Pedestrian crossing signal.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Pedestrian crossing signal..

car_questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
options: (1) Zebra-stripe pedestrian crossing line.
(2) Crossbar-stripe pedestrian crossing line.
(3) Stop line.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Zebra-stripe pedestrian crossing line..

car_questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
options: (1) Zebra-stripe pedestrian crossing line.
(2) Crossbar-stripe pedestrian crossing line.
(3) Stop line.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Crossbar-stripe pedestrian crossing line..

car_questions.question: When passing through an intersection and finding a pedestrian carrying a white cane or guide dog crossing the road, how should you proceed?
options: (1) Regardless of whether there are traffic signals, you should stop temporarily to let them pass first and maintain a wider safe distance.
(2) Go around them and pass directly.
(3) Sound the horn when approaching to alert the pedestrian to cross carefully.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Regardless of whether there are traffic signals, you should stop temporarily to let them pass first and maintain a wider safe distance..

car_questions.question: When driving through a pedestrian crossing on a green light, if a pedestrian crosses without following the signal, which of the following statements is INCORRECT?
options: (1) The pedestrian shall be fined NT$500.
(2) If the driver fails to stop and yield, the driver shall be fined NT$1,200.
(3) If the pedestrian's action causes the driver to be unable to react in time and an accident occurs, the pedestrian still bears responsibility.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) If the driver fails to stop and yield, the driver shall be fined NT$1,200..

car_questions.question: To eliminate the 'A-pillar blind spot' and prioritize pedestrians, what is the SAFEST action before a vehicle turns and approaches a pedestrian crossing?
options: (1) Slow down, briefly stop, and turn your head to check whether there are pedestrians behind the A-pillar; proceed only after confirming no one is there.
(2) Turn directly as long as no pedestrian is visible.
(3) Sound the horn to warn pedestrians and turn directly.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Slow down, briefly stop, and turn your head to check whether there are pedestrians behind the A-pillar; proceed only after confirming no one is there..

car_questions.question: The 'two-stage door opening method' means:
options: (1) Open the door in two stages without checking for traffic or pedestrians.
(2) First open the door slightly, check for traffic and pedestrians, then open fully.
(3) Both of the above.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) First open the door slightly, check for traffic and pedestrians, then open fully..

car_questions.question: Person A is a private passenger car driver, and Person B is a commercial heavy truck professional driver. Both have 2 red-light-running violations within one year. Under the new 2026 (ROC Year 115) system, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) Both A and B have reached the cumulative threshold for the three designated violations, and both must attend a corrective prevention class.
(2) A has not yet reached the threshold and is temporarily exempt; B, as a commercial heavy vehicle driver subject to a lower threshold, must attend a corrective prevention class.
(3) A and B share the same threshold of 3 violations; both currently have 2 violations and have not yet reached the threshold, so neither needs to attend.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) A has not yet reached the threshold and is temporarily exempt; B, as a commercial heavy vehicle driver subject to a lower threshold, must attend a corrective prevention class..

car_questions.question: Under the new regulations effective March 31, 2026, regarding drivers who must attend a corrective prevention course, which of the following is CORRECT?
options: (1) Car and motorcycle drivers who have accumulated three or more red-light violations within one year.
(2) Car and motorcycle drivers who have accumulated 12 or more demerit points due to different traffic violations within two years.
(3) Commercial large vehicle drivers who have run a red light once within one year.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Car and motorcycle drivers who have accumulated three or more red-light violations within one year..

car_questions.question: From March 31, 2026 onwards, how many times must a commercial large vehicle professional driver run a red light within one year before being required to attend a road traffic safety course at their own expense?
options: (1) 1 time.
(2) 2 times.
(3) 3 times.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) 2 times..

car_questions.question: Starting March 31, 2026, which specific traffic violations by professional drivers of large commercial vehicles must be included as subjects for road safety education sessions?
options: (1) Failing to yield according to right-of-way rules at unsignalized intersections.
(2) Failing to reduce speed as required when approaching pedestrian crossings, hospitals, and schools without traffic control signals.
(3) All of the above.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) All of the above..

car_questions.question: A driver approaches an intersection with a dedicated right-turn lane and is about to turn right. Which of the following behaviors best complies with regulations and embodies the spirit of 'proactive yielding'?
options: (1) If the straight-ahead lane is backed up, you may occupy the right-turn lane to go straight and then merge back into the main lane.
(2) You should enter the right-turn lane as required, slow down while turning, and stop temporarily to let pedestrians on the crosswalk pass first.
(3) Once the right-turn signal is lit, turning vehicles have the right of way and do not need to yield to pedestrians already in the intersection.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) You should enter the right-turn lane as required, slow down while turning, and stop temporarily to let pedestrians on the crosswalk pass first..

car_questions.question: When a large vehicle approaches a pedestrian crossing and a pedestrian has not yet stepped onto it but shows an intention to cross, which of the following is correct?
options: (1) Since the pedestrian has not yet entered, you may proceed first.
(2) Sound the horn to alert the pedestrian and then proceed.
(3) You should reduce speed and be ready to stop at any time to yield to the pedestrian.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) You should reduce speed and be ready to stop at any time to yield to the pedestrian..

car_questions.question: A driver approaches an intersection and fails to stop and yield to pedestrians on the crosswalk. Which of the following statements is INCORRECT?
options: (1) If the violation results in serious injury or death of another person, 2 demerit points are recorded.
(2) A fine of NT$1,200 to NT$6,000 is imposed.
(3) Failing to yield to visually impaired persons carrying a white cane or guide dog results in a fine of NT$2,400 to NT$7,200.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) If the violation results in serious injury or death of another person, 2 demerit points are recorded..

car_questions.question: A driver at an intersection sees a green light and prepares to turn left. At this moment, pedestrians are still slowly crossing on the pedestrian crosswalk markings. Which of the following behaviors is correct?
options: (1) Stop about 3 meters in front of the pedestrians and remain completely stationary until they have passed.
(2) Slowly glide toward the pedestrians, and once they have walked past the center line, accelerate and pass behind them.
(3) As long as the pedestrians have not yet walked into your intended path, you may maintain your speed and turn.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Stop about 3 meters in front of the pedestrians and remain completely stationary until they have passed..

car_questions.question: When approaching an unmarked intersection without a division between major and minor roads, if a car driver intends to turn left while an oncoming vehicle is simultaneously turning right into the same lane, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) The larger vehicle has the right of way; the smaller vehicle should yield.
(2) The left-turning vehicle should yield to the right-turning vehicle.
(3) The right- turning vehicle should yield to the left-turning vehicle.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) The right- turning vehicle should yield to the left-turning vehicle..

car_questions.question: At an unsignalized intersection where the cross road has lane dividing markings but the through road does not, yet both are two-way roads with one lane in each direction, and both vehicles are turning, how should they proceed?
options: (1) The vehicle on the road without lane dividing markings should stop and yield to the vehicle on the road with lane dividing markings.
(2) The vehicle from the road with fewer lanes should proactively stop and yield to the vehicle from the road with more lanes.
(3) The vehicle on the left should stop and yield to the vehicle on the right.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) The vehicle on the left should stop and yield to the vehicle on the right..

car_questions.question: When driving at night and a pedestrian is crossing ahead, what should you do?
options: (1) Switch to high beams to alert the pedestrian, then slow down, confirm it is safe, and proceed.
(2) Maintain low beams, slow down, confirm it is safe, and then proceed.
(3) Maintain low beams and keep speed while passing.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Maintain low beams, slow down, confirm it is safe, and then proceed..

car_questions.question: A car driver is traveling on a multi-lane road and is preparing to turn left at an intersection. Which of the following driving behaviors is incorrect and dangerous?
options: (1) Proceeding to the center of the intersection before turning, without encroaching on the oncoming lane.
(2) Making a wide sweeping turn or crossing multiple lanes directly from the second outermost lane to turn left.
(3) When a dedicated left-turn lane is available, changing into it early to wait.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Making a wide sweeping turn or crossing multiple lanes directly from the second outermost lane to turn left..

car_questions.question: When a car driver arrives at an intersection and the vehicle ahead has stopped to yield to pedestrians, which of the following is correct?
options: (1) Change lanes from behind, go around the vehicle ahead, and pass through the intersection directly.
(2) Honk repeatedly to urge the vehicle ahead to move.
(3) Wait in order behind the vehicle and yield to pedestrians to cross first.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Wait in order behind the vehicle and yield to pedestrians to cross first..

car_questions.question: A motor vehicle driver who approaches a pedestrian crossing or an intersection otherwise legally open to pedestrians and fails to stop and yield to pedestrians, thereby causing an accident resulting in injury, shall be fined NT$18,000–36,000, and their driver's license shall be:
options: (1) Revoked.
(2) Suspended for 6 months to 1 year.
(3) Suspended for 1 to 2 years.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Suspended for 1 to 2 years..

car_questions.question: When a vehicle passes through an intersection where no pedestrian crossing has been marked and encounters pedestrians crossing, how should the driver handle the situation?
options: (1) Sound the horn to signal pedestrians to cross quickly.
(2) Slow down and maintain a safe distance as appropriate when passing.
(3) Regardless of whether there is a traffic officer directing or signal indication, the driver must stop and yield to pedestrians first.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Regardless of whether there is a traffic officer directing or signal indication, the driver must stop and yield to pedestrians first..

car_questions.question: When approaching an intersection with a flashing red light signal, the driver should:
options: (1) Slow down while approaching, confirm it is safe, then pass carefully.
(2) Come to a full stop before the stop line, observe that there are no oncoming vehicles or pedestrians from left and right, then proceed.
(3) A flashing red light and a flashing yellow light carry the same right-of-way, so stopping and yielding is not required.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Come to a full stop before the stop line, observe that there are no oncoming vehicles or pedestrians from left and right, then proceed..

car_questions.question: A motor vehicle driver who, when approaching a pedestrian crossing or another intersection legally open to pedestrians, fails to stop and yield to a visually impaired person carrying a white cane or accompanied by a guide dog, shall be fined NT$:
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 2,400–7,200..

car_questions.question: Before a vehicle approaches a pedestrian crossing, how should the driver put the concept of stopping and yielding into practice?
options: (1) The driver should slow down and stop when pedestrians are crossing.
(2) If a pedestrian is still waiting at the roadside, pass as quickly as possible.
(3) When a pedestrian is one lane-width away from the vehicle, the driver may pass without slowing down.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) The driver should slow down and stop when pedestrians are crossing..

car_questions.question: When driving through an area or lane with a 'Pedestrian Priority Zone' start sign, the driver should:
options: (1) Slow down and be prepared to stop at any time to let pedestrians pass first.
(2) Honk the horn to remind pedestrians to be careful.
(3) As long as pedestrians are not blocking the way, drive at normal speed.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Slow down and be prepared to stop at any time to let pedestrians pass first..

car_questions.question: What is the legal liability of a driver who fails to stop and yield to pedestrians at a crosswalk as required, causing pedestrian injury or death?
options: (1) Must pay a fine and attend a training course.
(2) Fine and suspension of driver's license for 1 to 2 years.
(3) Fine, suspension/revocation of driver's license, criminal liability under the law, with sentence increased by up to one-half.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Fine, suspension/revocation of driver's license, criminal liability under the law, with sentence increased by up to one-half. | Year 115 Edition.

car_questions.question: When a turning vehicle approaches an intersection and encounters pedestrians, the correct defensive driving concept is:
options: (1) Slow down, turn first, then let the pedestrians in front of the vehicle pass.
(2) Stop temporarily and check the blind spots of the A-pillar and rearview mirrors, then start moving only after pedestrians have completely passed.
(3) Honk the horn to alert pedestrians to watch for the approaching vehicle.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Stop temporarily and check the blind spots of the A-pillar and rearview mirrors, then start moving only after pedestrians have completely passed..

car_questions.question: If the traffic light at an intersection has already turned green, but pedestrians on the crosswalk have not yet finished crossing, how should this be handled?
options: (1) The green light is on, so you may slowly approach the pedestrians to alert them.
(2) Go around the pedestrians and accelerate through.
(3) Continue to wait, and start moving only after they have safely crossed.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Continue to wait, and start moving only after they have safely crossed..

car_questions.question: When a vehicle reaches an intersection and the green light comes on, which of the following statements is most correct regarding how to proceed through the intersection?
options: (1) Green means permission to proceed; if there are pedestrians on the crosswalk, you may honk as a warning and then pass.
(2) When the light is green, pedestrians are not permitted to cross according to the rules, so the driver may proceed normally as indicated by the signal.
(3) Even when the light is green, you should still pay attention to activity at the intersection; if pedestrians are crossing, yield to them first.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Even when the light is green, you should still pay attention to activity at the intersection; if pedestrians are crossing, yield to them first..

car_questions.question: When approaching an intersection with a pedestrian crosswalk, what should the driver do?
options: (1) The driver may accelerate and pass if the pedestrian has not yet stepped onto the crosswalk.
(2) The driver may proceed as long as the signal light is green.
(3) The driver should slow down and be prepared to stop at any time to give pedestrians the right of way.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) The driver should slow down and be prepared to stop at any time to give pedestrians the right of way..

car_questions.question: The ultimate goal of establishing a 'yield culture at intersections' for road safety is:
options: (1) To create a people- centered, mutually respectful safe environment.
(2) To increase government tax revenue.
(3) To inconvenience drivers in order to reduce road traffic.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) To create a people- centered, mutually respectful safe environment..

car_questions.question: Regarding intersections where vehicles must stop and yield as required, which of the following is INCORRECT?
options: (1) Intersections with a stop sign or 'STOP' road marking.
(2) Intersections with a flashing red light signal.
(3) Intersections with a flashing yellow light signal.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Intersections with a flashing yellow light signal..

car_questions.question: What is the most important concept of 'defensive driving' at intersections?
options: (1) Securing the right of way first.
(2) Anticipating that others may violate traffic rules.
(3) The faster the speed, the safer it is.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Anticipating that others may violate traffic rules..

car_questions.question: Before preparing to turn right, at what distance should a driver move into the rightmost lane and activate the turn signal?
options: (1) 10 meters.
(2) 30 meters.
(3) Change lanes upon reaching the intersection.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) 30 meters..

car_questions.question: When a vehicle approaches a pedestrian crosswalk without traffic control signals, which of the following statements about the driver's required behavior is correct?
options: (1) If there are no pedestrians on the crosswalk, the driver may maintain the original speed to pass.
(2) Regardless of whether there are pedestrians on the crosswalk, the driver should slow down and approach cautiously.
(3) Before a pedestrian steps onto the crosswalk, the vehicle has the right of way.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Regardless of whether there are pedestrians on the crosswalk, the driver should slow down and approach cautiously..

car_questions.question: When the green signal light for "walking pedestrians" is flashing, it means:
options: (1) A warning to pedestrians that the remaining green light time is short; those who have not yet entered the road should avoid stepping in; those who have already entered the road should cross as quickly as possible or stop on a traffic island in the road.
(2) Pedestrians may cross the road.
(3) Pedestrians are prohibited from entering the road.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) A warning to pedestrians that the remaining green light time is short; those who have not yet entered the road should avoid stepping in; those who have already entered the road should cross as quickly as possible or stop on a traffic island in the road..

car_questions.question: When a large vehicle is turning right at an intersection, how should a small vehicle respond?
options: (1) Pass quickly from the right side.
(2) Drive close to the large vehicle to avoid being cut off.
(3) Drive behind the large vehicle and keep a safe distance to avoid entering the inner wheel difference zone.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Drive behind the large vehicle and keep a safe distance to avoid entering the inner wheel difference zone..

car_questions.question: At an intersection without signals, signs, and with equal right of way, when two vehicles are both going straight and arrive at the same time, how should they proceed?
options: (1) The one who honks first has priority.
(2) Large vehicles have priority.
(3) The vehicle coming from the left yields to the vehicle coming from the right.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) The vehicle coming from the left yields to the vehicle coming from the right..

car_questions.question: Regarding driving speed, according to speed limit signs or road markings, which of the following statements is INCORRECT for roads without speed limit signs or markings?
options: (1) Driving speed must not exceed 50 km/h; this also applies to slow lanes with a fast-slow lane dividing line.
(2) On roads without lane lines, traffic direction lines, or directional restriction lines, speed must not exceed 30 km/h.

(3) When passing road sections marked with curves, tunnels, schools, or hospital signs, unsignalized intersections, and other congested areas, drivers should slow down and be prepared to stop at any time.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Driving speed must not exceed 50 km/h; this also applies to slow lanes with a fast-slow lane dividing line..

car_questions.question: Two vehicles arrive simultaneously at an uncontrolled intersection from different directions, with the same number of lanes in their respective directions of travel. Regarding right of way, which of the following is correct?
options: (1) The left-side vehicle is going straight and the right-side vehicle is turning; the left-side vehicle must yield to the right-side vehicle.
(2) Both vehicles are going straight; the left-side vehicle must yield to the right-side vehicle.
(3) Both vehicles are going straight; the right-side vehicle must yield to the left-side vehicle.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Both vehicles are going straight; the left-side vehicle must yield to the right-side vehicle..

car_questions.question: When a driver performs a "head-swing check" at an intersection, the main purpose is:
options: (1) To relieve neck fatigue.
(2) To avoid blind spots caused by the vehicle's A-pillar obstructing the line of sight, and to confirm whether pedestrians are present.
(3) To let the police know you are watching the road, in order to avoid a fine.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) To avoid blind spots caused by the vehicle's A-pillar obstructing the line of sight, and to confirm whether pedestrians are present..

car_questions.question: When approaching an intersection and the signal changes from green to yellow, what is the safest and most lawful action?
options: (1) Accelerate to pass through the intersection before the red light.
(2) If the front wheels have not yet crossed the stop line, stop and do not proceed through the intersection.
(3) Always brake to an emergency stop.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) If the front wheels have not yet crossed the stop line, stop and do not proceed through the intersection..

car_questions.question: Which of the following situations does NOT fall under the definition of "running a red light" in traffic regulations?
options: (1) The signal has just turned red and the driver still accelerates to pass through the intersection.
(2) When the red light comes on, the vehicle crosses the stop line and stops on the pedestrian crossing.
(3) When the yellow light comes on, the vehicle body has already completely passed the stop line.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) When the yellow light comes on, the vehicle body has already completely passed the stop line..

car_questions.question: When a driver passes through an intersection and encounters a red light, if the front wheels cross the stop line and the vehicle stops on the pedestrian crossing, does this constitute running a red light?
options: (1) As long as the car has not driven completely through the intersection, it does not count.
(2) Even though the front wheels crossed the stop line, as long as the vehicle has stopped, it does not count.
(3) It is considered running a red light.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) It is considered running a red light..

car_questions.question: Regarding the criteria for determining a red-light violation, which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: (1) After the red light turns on, the vehicle still crosses the stop line into the connecting road section, including left turn, straight, U-turn, and right turn (except where permitted by arrow green light).
(2) After the red light turns on, the vehicle body still crosses the stop line and is sufficient to obstruct the passage of pedestrians (if there is a crosswalk) and vehicles in other directions.
(3) When the signal facing the vehicle is not a red light, the vehicle has already crossed the stop line.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) When the signal facing the vehicle is not a red light, the vehicle has already crossed the stop line..

car_questions.question: After the red light turns on, the vehicle body still crosses the stop line. Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: (1) If it is sufficient to obstruct the passage of pedestrians (with a crosswalk) and vehicles in other directions, it is deemed running a red light.
(2) As long as the vehicle does not encroach on the pedestrian crosswalk, it will not be penalized.
(3) If only the front wheels cross the stop line, it is regarded as 'failure to comply with road marking instructions'.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) As long as the vehicle does not encroach on the pedestrian crosswalk, it will not be penalized..

car_questions.question: A motor vehicle driver passing through a signalized intersection, under circumstances where there are no arrow directional signals, runs a red light while turning left or right. The applicable penalty is:
options: (1) Turning right without following the instructions of signs, road markings, or signals.
(2) Running a red light.
(3) Combined penalty for both turning without following the instructions of signs, road markings, or signals, and running a red light.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Running a red light..

car_questions.question: A motor vehicle driver following behind a large vehicle has their line of sight obstructed and fails to notice the signal has turned red, then crosses the stop line and enters the intersection to continue driving. Which of the following is correct?
options: (1) Because the line of sight was blocked without intentional action, the driver should be exempt from penalty.
(2) The driver should bear the liability for the violation of 'running a red light'.
(3) The large vehicle ahead should bear the liability for the violation of obstructing the line of sight.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The driver should bear the liability for the violation of 'running a red light'..

car_questions.question: At an intersection with a malfunctioning traffic signal, when a person legally authorized to direct traffic on- site signals drivers to proceed, what is the effect?
options: (1) The directing personnel's hand signals take precedence over the traffic signals, and it is lawful to proceed by following their directions.
(2) The displayed red light signal shall prevail; otherwise it is deemed running a red light.
(3) The driver should judge based on the traffic flow independently, as hand signals are only advisory in nature.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) The directing personnel's hand signals take precedence over the traffic signals, and it is lawful to proceed by following their directions..

car_questions.question: When a car is making a left turn and the signal changes to red before it has crossed the stop line, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) It constitutes "failure to turn left as required" and is subject to a fine of NT$600.
(2) It constitutes "running a red light" because the signal was red at the moment it crossed the stop line.
(3) It is considered "residual clearance at an intersection" and is not subject to penalty.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) It constitutes "running a red light" because the signal was red at the moment it crossed the stop line..

car_questions.question: Regarding the correct procedure when a car driver runs a red light by crossing into the opposing lane while yielding to a fire truck on duty, which of the following is correct?
options: (1) Drive away from the intersection after yielding and ignore any traffic ticket.
(2) Come to a safe stop as soon as possible after yielding; if cited, you may file an appeal with supporting facts to have the ticket dismissed.
(3) Accelerate through the intersection to make way for the fire truck.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Come to a safe stop as soon as possible after yielding; if cited, you may file an appeal with supporting facts to have the ticket dismissed..

car_questions.question: When a vehicle reaches an unsigned intersection and a vehicle on a secondary road encounters a vehicle on a main road, which of the following correctly states the right-of-way rule?
options: (1) The secondary road vehicle must yield to the main road vehicle.
(2) It depends on the speed of both vehicles; the faster one goes first.
(3) As long as the main road vehicle is still far away, the secondary road vehicle may proceed directly through the intersection.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) The secondary road vehicle must yield to the main road vehicle..

car_questions.question: When a car driver enters a signalized intersection while traffic is congested, thereby impeding the passage of other vehicles, which of the following is correct?
options: (1) It is treated as running a red light and is subject to a fine of NT$1,800 to NT$5,400, plus 3 demerit points on the driver's record.
(2) A fine of NT$600 to NT$1,800 is imposed.
(3) The situation is special and the driver cannot be held responsible, so no penalty is imposed.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) A fine of NT$600 to NT$1,800 is imposed..

car_questions.question: When a vehicle crosses the stop line into the intersection area to make a U-turn while the light is red, how should this behavior be determined?
options: (1) It constitutes an "illegal U-turn" and is subject to a fine.
(2) It constitutes "running a red light" because the vehicle crossed the stop line and entered the intersection area while the light was red.
(3) As long as the U-turn does not go beyond the far end of the intersection, there is no violation.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) It constitutes "running a red light" because the vehicle crossed the stop line and entered the intersection area while the light was red..

car_questions.question: At an intersection with traffic signals, turning right directly when the red light is on is classified as what type of violation?
options: (1) It is considered running a red light.
(2) It is not considered running a red light, but is considered a right turn on red violation.
(3) As long as no accident occurs, it is not considered running a red light.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) It is considered running a red light..

car_questions.question: At an intersection without marked boundaries, if a vehicle ignores the red light and attempts to cross the intersection, with the vehicle body already extending beyond the stop line to the extent that it obstructs the passage of people and vehicles from other directions, is this considered running a red light?
options: (1) Yes.
(3) No specific regulation.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Yes..

car_questions.question: When an ambulance is not performing emergency rescue duties and is not sounding its siren, and it runs a red light at a signal-controlled intersection, is this considered running a red light?
options: (1) Yes.
(3) No specific regulation.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Yes..

car_questions.question: Which of the following situations would be determined as 'running a red light'?
options: (1) The vehicle had already completely entered the intersection before the red light came on and passed through safely.
(2) When the red light came on, the front wheels crossed the stop line and the vehicle stopped on the pedestrian crossing.
(3) The vehicle was still stopped before the stop line when the red light came on.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) When the red light came on, the front wheels crossed the stop line and the vehicle stopped on the pedestrian crossing..

car_questions.question: Regarding the legal consequences when a vehicle's body straddles the pedestrian crossing while waiting at a red light, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) It is treated as 'improper temporary parking' and subject to a fine of NT$300.
(2) It is penalized as 'running a red light'.
(3) If there are no pedestrians passing during that time, there is no violation.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) It is penalized as 'running a red light'..

car_questions.question: When a motor vehicle driver approaches an intersection and makes a turn, the driver should:
options: (1) At a multi-lane intersection, the driver may turn left directly from the outer lane.
(2) When turning left, activate the turn signal 30 meters before the intersection and move into the inner lane or left-turn lane.
(3) At a multi-lane intersection, vehicles in the inner lane may turn right directly.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) When turning left, activate the turn signal 30 meters before the intersection and move into the inner lane or left-turn lane..

car_questions.question: While waiting at a red light, if the cross-direction signal has already turned red but your own direction's green light has not yet lit up and you start moving early, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) This constitutes 'running a red light,' because the signal was still red when the vehicle crossed the stop line.
(2) This constitutes 'normal starting,' in line with the general principle of traffic flow optimization.
(3) This constitutes 'failing to use lights properly when starting.'
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) This constitutes 'running a red light,' because the signal was still red when the vehicle crossed the stop line..

car_questions.question: A lane is designated as a 'left-turn only lane.' When only the straight-ahead and right-turn green arrows are lit, what is the legal consequence for a driver who turns left using the left-turn only lane?
options: (1) It is deemed 'running a red light,' because proceeding is prohibited when that directional arrow is not lit.
(2) It is deemed a 'legal turn,' but the driver bears an absolute duty of care regarding right-of-way.
(3) It is deemed 'failing to follow road markings,' subject to a fine of NT$900.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) It is deemed 'failing to follow road markings,' subject to a fine of NT$900..

car_questions.question: When a vehicle approaches a pedestrian crossing where pedestrians are already crossing, what distance must the vehicle maintain from pedestrians to avoid a violation?
options: (1) The vehicle must maintain a distance of at least 3 meters.
(2) The vehicle must maintain a safe yielding distance of 1 meter.
(3) As long as the vehicle does not collide with a pedestrian, there is no specific distance requirement.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) The vehicle must maintain a distance | Year 115 Edition of at least 3 meters..

car_questions.question: When a vehicle passes through an intersection where no pedestrian crossing has been marked and encounters pedestrians crossing, how should the driver handle the situation?
options: (1) Sound the horn to signal pedestrians to cross quickly.
(2) Slow down and maintain a safe distance as appropriate when passing.
(3) Regardless of whether there is a traffic officer directing or signal indication, the driver must stop and yield to pedestrians first.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Regardless of whether there is a traffic officer directing or signal indication, the driver must stop and yield to pedestrians first..

car_questions.question: Regarding the difference between a 'flashing red light' and a 'flashing yellow light,' which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) A flashing red light means vehicles must 'stop and then proceed'; a flashing yellow light means vehicles must 'slow down when approaching, pay attention to safety, and pass with caution.'
(2) For both signals, drivers only need to ease off the accelerator to pass.
(3) A flashing yellow light requires a complete stop before proceeding; a flashing red light only requires slowing down.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) A flashing red light means vehicles must 'stop and then proceed'; a flashing yellow light means vehicles must 'slow down when approaching, pay attention to safety, and pass with caution.'.

car_questions.question: When a vehicle approaches a roundabout intersection without traffic signals, which of the following statements about right-of-way priority is correct?
options: (1) Following the principle of 'yield to vehicles from the left, give way to vehicles on the right,' vehicles on the right side waiting to enter the roundabout have priority.
(2) Vehicles already circulating inside the roundabout have priority; other vehicles should enter in sequence afterwards.
(3) Vehicles coming from a wider road or a road with heavier traffic have priority to enter the roundabout.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Vehicles already circulating inside the roundabout have priority; other vehicles should enter in sequence afterwards..

car_questions.question: When driving a vehicle into a 'pedestrian priority zone' and a pedestrian is walking in the middle of the road ahead without noticing the approaching vehicle from behind, what is the correct defensive driving action?
options: (1) Lightly tap the horn to alert the pedestrian, then accelerate and pass after they move aside.
(2) Maintain a safe following distance behind the pedestrian, slow down and wait; do not honk the horn to pressure them to yield.
(3) Quickly drive past the pedestrian through the narrow space on their side to clear the road.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Maintain a safe following distance behind the pedestrian, slow down and wait; do not honk the horn to pressure them to yield..

car_questions.question: When a motor vehicle driver reaches a signalized intersection shared with mass rapid transit vehicles and turns right on a red light, what is the fine in New Taiwan Dollars?
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) NT$1,200–3,600..

car_questions.question: Regarding the 'school zone start' sign installed on roads, what is its primary legal and regulatory function?
options: (1) To indicate that the road section is the main route for students traveling to and from school, reminding drivers to slow down.
(2) To indicate that no vehicles are permitted to enter the road section; only school buses and faculty/staff vehicles may pass.
(3) To indicate that the road section is private land, accessible only to the school's teachers and students during specific hours.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) To indicate that the road section is the main route for students traveling to and from school, reminding drivers to slow down..

car_questions.question: At an intersection equipped with both a 'left-turn arrow' and a 'circular' green light, if the 'circular green light' is currently illuminated, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) The circular green light permits travel in all directions; vehicles may turn left after yielding to oncoming through traffic.
(2) You must wait until the left-turn arrow green light is illuminated before turning left.
(3) When the circular green light is on, left turns are prohibited under any circumstances.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) The circular green light permits travel in all directions; vehicles may turn left after yielding to oncoming through traffic..

car_questions.question: When driving on a mountain road and seeing a 'Danger' warning sign ahead with no supplementary explanation plate, how should the driver respond?
options: (1) The sign is only a general reminder; maintain current speed and proceed.
(2) Heighten alertness, reduce speed and proceed slowly, watching for all possible hazards ahead.
(3) There must be falling rocks on that section; stop immediately to observe before proceeding.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Heighten alertness, reduce speed and proceed slowly, watching for all possible hazards ahead..

car_questions.question: When a vehicle reaches an unsignalized intersection where no major or minor road designation exists and the number of lanes is equal, which of the following statements is INCORRECT?
options: (1) A turning vehicle shall stop and yield to a through-going vehicle.
(2) When both are through-going vehicles or both are turning vehicles, the vehicle on the left shall stop and yield to the vehicle on the right.
(3) The vehicle that entered the intersection first has the right of way.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) The vehicle that entered the intersection first has the right of way..

car_questions.question: Where is a triangular 'Attention: Signal Ahead' warning sign most likely to be installed?
options: (1) At intersections with traffic control signals, to enhance signal visibility.
(2) At an appropriate distance in front of an intersection where signals are difficult to notice, to warn drivers in advance.
(3) At unsignalized intersections, to replace traffic control signals in regulating traffic.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) At an appropriate distance in front of an intersection where signals are difficult to notice, to warn drivers in advance..

car_questions.question: The traffic control hand signal shown in the figure indicates:
options: (1) All vehicles stop.

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) All vehicles stop..

car_questions.question: Traffic control personnel can use hand gestures to guide moving vehicles. What does this gesture mean?
options: (1) Vehicles coming from the left turn left.

car_questions.question: A driver reaches an intersection and a traffic control officer signals the driver to turn left. How should the driver proceed?
options: (1) Turn left immediately as directed; the officer has ensured the intersection is clear, so no need to watch for other vehicles or pedestrians.
(2) Turn left as directed, but still slow down while turning and watch for oncoming straight-through vehicles and pedestrians at the intersection.
(3) Observe and confirm safety independently before deciding whether to turn left; the hand signal is only a suggestion.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Turn left as directed, but still slow down while turning and watch for oncoming straight-through vehicles and pedestrians at the intersection..

car_questions.question: Before a traffic signal changes from green to red, it will first display yellow. Regarding the meaning of the yellow light, which of the following is correct?
options: (1) The yellow light means "caution," and vehicles should slow down but may continue through the intersection.

(3) The yellow light is merely a transitional signal between red and green with no legal regulatory effect.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The yellow light warns drivers and pedestrians that the red light is about to appear and the right of way will be lost; vehicles that have already passed the stop line should proceed quickly, while those that have not should stop and wait..

car_questions.question: Traffic control personnel can use hand gestures to guide moving vehicles. What does the gesture made by the traffic control officer in the image indicate?

car_questions.question: Regarding the markings of pedestrian crosswalks, which of the following correctly describes the principle for installing 'ladder markings' versus 'zebra markings'?
options: (1) Ladder markings are installed on road sections without signals; zebra markings are installed at signalized intersections.

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Ladder markings are installed at signalized intersections; zebra markings are installed on road sections without signals..

car_questions.question: When a driver approaches an intersection and finds that the gestures of a traffic control officer are inconsistent with the traffic signal indications, how should the driver comply?
options: (1) Follow the traffic signals, because signals have legal authority and hand gestures are for reference only.

options: (1) Guides vehicle drivers to travel along the indicated route.

car_questions.question: What is the white inverted triangle marking on the ground?
options: (1) Yield line.

car_questions.question: When a driver passes through an intersection and sees a white inverted triangle 'yield line' marking on the road surface, which of the following driving behaviors complies with the regulations?
options: (1) Must come to a complete stop before the marking, and may proceed only after confirming it is safe.

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Should slow down, pay attention to traffic coming from the main road, and yield priority to vehicles on the main road..

car_questions.question: What does this police hand signal mean?
options: (1) Oncoming traffic stop.

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Oncoming traffic stop..

car_questions.question: When a motor vehicle driver approaches a light rail transit intersection, what should they do?
options: (1) Slow down, pass after confirming safety, and may stop on the track area if necessary.

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Pay attention to train movements, pass quickly under safe conditions, and must not stop on the track area..

car_questions.question: Regarding 'lane control signals,' which of the following descriptions is correct?

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) A red 'X' light and a green '↓' or '→' arrow light control the use of individual lanes, commonly used on reversible lane sections..

car_questions.question: When a driver is traveling on an unmarked road section and encounters a 'zebra crossing' with pedestrians crossing, how should the driver respond?

car_questions.question: When a driver sees a 'Attention: Signal Ahead' warning sign while driving, how should the driver respond?

(3) It indicates the signal ahead is for reference only; the driver may decide whether to proceed.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) It indicates there is a traffic control signal ahead; pay attention in advance and prepare to follow signal instructions..

car_questions.question: When the traffic control signal shows green, how should a driver proceed?

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) You may proceed, but when turning, you must still yield to vehicles going straight and pedestrians in motion..

car_questions.question: When a driver approaches an intersection and sees a traffic officer making a stop gesture toward their direction, where should the driver stop the vehicle?
options: (1) Stop immediately in place, regardless of the vehicle's current position.

(3) Slowly drive to the center of the intersection then stop, to help the officer identify the vehicle's movement.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Stop in front of the stop line at the intersection; if there is no stop line, stop in front of the edge of the intersection..

car_questions.question: On which type of road section is the 'Two-Way Traffic' warning sign most commonly installed?
options: (1) On all two-way roads, reminding drivers to watch for oncoming vehicles.
(2) Ahead of road sections where a one-way road is about to end and transition to two-way traffic, to warn drivers in advance.
(3) Ahead of road sections where the number of lanes decreases, reminding drivers to watch for merging traffic.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Ahead of road sections where a one-way road is about to end and transition to two-way traffic, to warn drivers in advance..

car_questions.question: Where is the "Watch for Children" warning sign most commonly placed?
options: (1) Roads near busy commercial districts or tourist attractions.

car_questions.question: Traffic officers use different hand gestures to signal stop or go to different directions. Which of the following descriptions of hand signals is correct?

car_questions.question: What does the hand gesture shown in the picture by a traffic police officer on duty represent?
options: (1) Vehicles from the front must stop.

car_questions.question: Traffic control signals use red, yellow, and green lights to regulate the movement of vehicles on the road. Which of the following correctly describes the function of traffic control signals?
options: (1) Red and yellow lights flash alternately to warn drivers to slow down or stop before proceeding.

car_questions.question: A red triangular "Danger" warning sign is placed on a road. What is the purpose of this sign?

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) There is a hazardous road condition ahead for which no dedicated warning sign exists; drivers are reminded to proceed with caution..

car_questions.question: The section where a highway or expressway connects with other roads or other highways/expressways, forming a grade-separated interchange via ramps, is called what?
options: (1) Interchange.

car_questions.question: When a motor vehicle driver approaches a multi-lane roundabout, which of the following regarding vehicle right-of-way is correct?

car_questions.question: When a driver sees a 'Right Lane Ends' warning sign ahead while driving, how should they respond?

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The right side of the road ahead narrows; slow down, move to the left lane in advance, and watch for merging traffic..

car_questions.question: When approaching an intersection having already passed the stop line and the yellow light comes on, you should:

car_questions.question: At an intersection with a traffic island separating fast and slow lanes, vehicles in the slow lane:

car_questions.question: When opposing left-turning and right-turning vehicles must enter the same lane, which has priority?
options: (1) The right-turning vehicle goes first.

car_questions.question: When reaching an intersection with a malfunctioning signal and no traffic officer:

car_questions.question: At an intersection where both a traffic officer and traffic signals are present, which takes precedence?

car_questions.question: When approaching a pedestrian crossing, you should:

(3) A fine of NT$1,800–5,400 and demerit points recorded.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) A fine of NT$1,800–5,400 and demerit points recorded..

car_questions.question: A motor vehicle driver who runs a red light and is cited on the spot, in addition to a fine, shall also have demerit points recorded:
options: (1) 1 point.
(2) 2 points.
(3) 3 points.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 3 points..

car_questions.question: Before a multi-lane intersection:
options: (1) You must not change lanes across the double white solid line.
(2) You may change lanes across the double white solid line for turning convenience.
(3) You may change lanes across the double yellow solid line.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) You must not change lanes across the double white solid line..

car_questions.question: When the traffic signal is green at an intersection:
options: (1) You have the right of way and should speed up.
(2) You should stop and restart.
(3) You should slow down and proceed carefully.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) You should slow down and proceed carefully..

car_questions.question: When the traffic signal is a flashing yellow light at an intersection, the correct action is:
options: (1) Stop, look, and then proceed.
(2) No need to look, pass quickly.
(3) Slow down, look left and right carefully, and proceed.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Slow down, look left and right carefully, and proceed..

car_questions.question: The safer approach when driving through an unsignalized intersection is to look:
options: (1) Right first, then left.
(2) Left first, then right.
(3) Either side first.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Left first, then right..

car_questions.question: A motor vehicle driver who runs a red light at a signalized intersection shared by mass rapid transit vehicles and is cited on the spot shall be:
options: (1) Fined NT$1,800–5,400 and have violation points recorded.
(2) Have their driver's license suspended for 1 month.
(3) Fined NT$3,600–10,800 and have violation points recorded.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Fined NT$3,600–10,800 and have violation points recorded..

car_questions.question: When driving through an intersection shared with mass rapid transit vehicles where the audio/visual signals have malfunctioned and no traffic officer is present, the driver should:
options: (1) Ignore the transit vehicles and proceed.
(2) Stop, look, and listen for transit vehicles from both directions before proceeding.
(3) Honk to warn pedestrians and proceed.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Stop, look, and listen for transit vehicles from both directions before proceeding..

car_questions.question: How should a vehicle safely pass through a light rail signalized intersection?
options: (1) Check for light rail and use your own judgment.
(2) When the straight arrow green light is on, you may freely turn left or right.
(3) Follow the signs, markings, and signals at the intersection.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Follow the signs, markings, and signals at the intersection..

car_questions.question: Which driving behavior is incorrect?
options: (1) The yellow zone along light rail tracks is a no-stopping area; pass through quickly.
(2) When the light rail audio/visual warning sounds, ignore it and speed up.
(3) When passing through intersections shared with light rail transit, obey traffic signals.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) When the light rail audio/visual warning sounds, ignore it and speed up..

car_questions.question: A motor vehicle driver who approaches a pedestrian crossing or an intersection otherwise legally open to pedestrians and fails to stop and yield to pedestrians, thereby causing an accident resulting in injury, shall be fined NT$18,000–36,000, and their driver's license shall be:
options: (1) Revoked.
(2) Suspended for 6 months to 1 year.
(3) Suspended for 1 to 2 years.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Suspended for 6 months to 1 year..

car_questions.question: A motor vehicle driver who approaches a pedestrian crossing or an intersection otherwise legally open to pedestrians and fails to stop and yield to pedestrians, thereby causing an accident resulting in serious/severe injury (causing severe injury or death), shall be fined NT$18,000–36,000, and their driver's license shall be:
options: (1) Revoked.
(2) Suspended for 6 months to 1 year.
(3) Suspended for 1 to 2 years.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Suspended for 1 to 2 years..

car_questions.question: On a road with a dividing island separating fast and slow lanes, which of the following turning rules is correct for large vehicle drivers?
options: (1) Slow lane vehicles may turn left, and fast lane vehicles may also turn right, as long as they watch for oncoming traffic.
(2) Slow lane vehicles may not turn left, and fast lane vehicles may not turn right, except where signs, markings, or signals indicate otherwise.
(3) Large vehicle drivers may choose their turning method according to traffic flow conditions.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Slow lane vehicles may not turn left, and fast lane vehicles may not turn right, except where signs, markings, or signals indicate otherwise..

car_questions.question: Regarding a motor vehicle approaching an intersection without signals or with malfunctioning signals and no traffic officer directing traffic, which of the following statements is INCORRECT?
options: (1) Vehicles on a secondary road shall stop and yield to vehicles on a main road.
(2) Where no signs, markings, or signals designate main or secondary roads, vehicles on the road with fewer lanes shall stop and yield to vehicles on the road with more lanes.
(3) When both vehicles are going straight or both are turning, the vehicle on the right shall stop and yield to the vehicle on the left.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) When both vehicles are going straight or both are turning, the vehicle on the right shall stop and yield to the vehicle on the left..

car_questions.question: Regarding the rules for motor vehicles proceeding and turning at intersections, which of the following statements is INCORRECT?
options: (1) When merging from two same-direction lanes into one lane, if there is no straight-through lane, vehicles in the inner lane shall yield to vehicles in the outer lane.
(2) When merging from two same-direction lanes into one lane, vehicles shall yield to vehicles in the straight-through lane.
(3) During traffic congestion, vehicles in inner and outer lanes shall mutually yield, taking turns alternately vehicle by vehicle, while maintaining safe following distances and intervals.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) When merging from two same-direction lanes into one lane, if there is no straight-through lane, vehicles in the inner lane shall yield to vehicles in the outer lane..

car_questions.question: When a vehicle is turning, which of the following is INCORRECT?
options: (1) A motor vehicle on a road with two or more same-direction lanes shall not drive in the inner lane except when preparing to turn left.
(2) At an intersection with dedicated left-turn or right-turn lanes, straight-through vehicles shall not occupy the dedicated turning lanes.
(3) At an unsignalized intersection where both roads have the same number of lanes, turning vehicles shall stop and yield to straight-through vehicles.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) A motor vehicle on a road with two or more same-direction lanes shall not drive in the inner lane except when preparing to turn left..

car_questions.question: Regarding the rules for motor vehicle drivers when turning or changing lanes, which of the following statements is CORRECT?
options: (1) Occupying the oncoming lane to make a left turn before reaching the center of an intersection is subject to a fine of NT$600–1,800.
(2) At an intersection with dedicated left- turn or right-turn lanes, straight-through vehicles may drive in the dedicated lane.
(3) When turning left across multiple lanes, one must not enter the inner lane.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Occupying the oncoming lane to make a left turn before reaching the center of an intersection is subject to a fine of NT$600–1,800..

car_questions.question: When a motor vehicle driver fails to yield to oncoming straight-through traffic when turning left at an intersection, what penalty shall be imposed?
options: (1) A fine and suspension of the license plate.
(3) A fine and revocation of the driver's license.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) A fine of NT$600–1,800..

car_questions.question: When a vehicle turns left (right), it should first activate the left (right) turn signal at both the front and rear of the vehicle; when changing lanes, it should first activate the signal in the direction of the intended lane change. Which of the following is correct?
options: (1) The turn signal should be displayed for 5 seconds.
(2) The turn signal should remain on until the turn or lane change is completed.
(3) The turn signal only needs to be displayed briefly.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The turn signal should remain on until the turn or lane change is completed..

car_questions.question: Which of the following vehicles will cause an inner wheel difference (off-tracking) when turning?
options: (1) Small vehicles.
(2) Large vehicles.
(3) Both.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Both..

car_questions.question: When a motor vehicle driver turns right at a multi-lane intersection, how should they choose their lane?
options: (1) Any lane may be used to turn right.
(2) Follow the road signs and markings, or use the outermost lane to turn.
(3) Turning from the inner lane is safer.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Follow the road signs and markings, or use the outermost lane to turn..

car_questions.question: When a motor vehicle driver is turning left at an intersection and there are already vehicles waiting to turn ahead, what is the appropriate action?
options: (1) Go around the vehicle in front and turn left first.
(2) Wait in order behind the other vehicles.
(3) Directly enter the oncoming lane to make the turn.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Wait in order behind the other vehicles..

car_questions.question: When a motor vehicle driver is at an intersection equipped with traffic guide lines and does not follow the guide lines but cuts directly into the turning path, what applies?
options: (1) As long as it does not affect other vehicles, there is no violation.
(2) Failure to comply with road marking instructions is subject to a fine.
(3) It is sufficient to simply slow down.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Failure to comply with road marking instructions is subject to a fine..

car_questions.question: A person who drives a small vehicle without a valid driver’s license shall be fined:
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) NT$36,000–60,000..

car_questions.question: Regarding the 'directional guide sign', what is its formal functional definition under traffic regulations?
options: (1) Used to indicate the route direction and number for travel.

(3) Used to mark the road section as a pedestrian priority zone where vehicles must slow down.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Used to indicate the route direction and number for travel..

car_questions.question: Regarding traffic signs at roundabout sections, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) The 'roundabout' warning sign is placed inside the roundabout intersection, instructing vehicles to travel in a counterclockwise direction.
(2) The 'roundabout' warning sign is placed in advance before approaching the roundabout section, to warn of the upcoming roundabout intersection ahead.
(3) The 'roundabout' warning sign and the 'roundabout travel direction' sign have the same function and can be used interchangeably.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The 'roundabout' warning sign is placed in advance before approaching the roundabout section, to warn of the upcoming roundabout intersection ahead..

car_questions.question: When a motor vehicle travels to an unsignalized intersection, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) A through vehicle must yield to a turning vehicle.
(2) When a through vehicle has not yet entered the intersection, the turning vehicle goes first.
(3) An oncoming turning vehicle must yield to a through vehicle.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) An oncoming turning vehicle must yield to a through vehicle..

car_questions.question: A driver approaching an intersection sees a 'right turn only' compliance sign, but their destination is to the left. What should they do?
options: (1) The sign is only advisory; the driver may decide the turning direction as needed.
(2) They should turn right as indicated by the sign, then find another appropriate route to reach the destination.
(3) They may proceed straight through the intersection and turn left at the next intersection to reach the destination.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) They should turn right as indicated by the sign, then find another appropriate route to reach the destination..

car_questions.question: When a car travels on a road with a median island dividing fast and slow lanes, unless otherwise indicated by signs, markings, or signals, what is the general rule?
options: (1) Vehicles in the fast lane may not make a left turn.
(2) Vehicles in the slow lane must first merge into the fast lane before turning right.
(3) Vehicles traveling in the slow lane may not make a left turn.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Vehicles traveling in the slow lane may not make a left turn..

car_questions.question: When driving through a long tunnel and encountering an emergency such as a fire, what should the driver do?
options: (1) Stay calm, immediately pull the vehicle to the side of the tunnel, and clear the lane for emergency vehicles to enter.
(2) Use the vehicle cross-passage to make a U-turn and quickly leave the scene.
(3) Stop the vehicle in place.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Stay calm, immediately pull the vehicle to the side of the tunnel, and clear the lane for emergency vehicles to enter..

car_questions.question: Under which circumstances may a motor vehicle driver sound the horn?
options: (1) When approaching a sharp curve.
(2) When intending to overtake the vehicle ahead in the same lane on a suburban road.
(3) Both of the above are permitted.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Both of the above are permitted..

car_questions.question: When a car experiences a tire skid while navigating a curve, what is the safest course of action?
options: (1) Immediately press the brakes to slow down.
(2) Quickly turn the steering wheel to correct the direction.
(3) Release the accelerator and avoid sudden acceleration or sudden braking.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Release the accelerator and avoid sudden acceleration or sudden braking..

car_questions.question: When a driver sees a 'Junction' warning sign ahead, how should they respond?
options: (1) There is an intersection ahead; slow down and watch for vehicles that may merge from the side.
(2) The road ahead is about to end; prepare to make a U-turn or take a detour.
(3) The road ahead splits into two lanes; choose the inner lane and accelerate away from the diverging section.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) There is an intersection ahead; slow down and watch for vehicles that may merge from the side..

car_questions.question: When a car approaches a multi-lane roundabout, which of the following statements about right-of-way is correct?
options: (1) Vehicles in the inner lane should be given priority.
(2) Vehicles in the outer lane should be given priority.
(3) Vehicles coming from the wider road or the road with heavier traffic have priority to enter the roundabout.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Vehicles in the inner lane should be given priority..

car_questions.question: What does this sign represent?
options: (1) Mandatory direction of travel.

car_questions.question: When reaching an intersection with a dedicated left-turn signal, what should the driver do when the left- turn signal lights up?
options: (1) Immediately accelerate through the intersection to avoid disrupting traffic behind.
(2) Turn left as indicated by the signal and pay attention to other vehicles and pedestrians.
(3) Stop first to observe, and turn left slowly only after confirming no vehicles are present.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Turn left as indicated by the signal and pay attention to other vehicles and pedestrians..

car_questions.question: On a road with a dividing island separating fast and slow lanes, which of the following rules regarding turning is correct for vehicles traveling in the slow lane?
options: (1) Under safe conditions, vehicles in the slow lane may turn left at any time.
(2) Vehicles in the slow lane may not turn left directly.

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Vehicles in the slow lane may not turn left directly..

car_questions.question: A car is waiting to turn left at an intersection. When the signal changes to a circular green light, how should the driver proceed?
options: (1) To maintain traffic flow, turn on the turn signal and make the left turn immediately.

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Must wait until there are no oncoming vehicles going straight, and may only turn left after confirming it is safe; preemptive passage is not allowed..

car_questions.question: When turning right at an intersection, you should first:

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Display a turn signal or hand signal..

car_questions.question: When turning right:
