(2) First display the left turn signal.
(3) Extend the right arm horizontally.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) First display the right turn signal at the front and rear..

car_questions.question: On road sections with curve, slope, or narrow road signs, you should:
options: (1) Speed up to avoid congestion.
(2) Honk at the vehicle ahead to speed up.
(3) Slow down and be prepared to stop at any time.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Slow down and be prepared to stop at any time..

car_questions.question: A vehicle in the inner lane intending to turn left at an intersection should:
options: (1) Display the turn signal 30 meters before the intersection and turn left at the center of the intersection.
(2) Turn left immediately upon reaching the intersection.
(3) Display the right turn signal and turn left.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Display the turn signal 30 meters before the intersection and turn left at the center of the intersection..

car_questions.question: On road sections with curve, slope, narrow bridge, or tunnel signs, or at railway level crossings:
options: (1) U- turns are allowed.
(2) U-turns are allowed at speeds below 5 km/h.
(3) U-turns are not allowed.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) U-turns are not allowed..

car_questions.question: Before making a U-turn:
options: (1) Stop and display the left turn signal or hand signal, check for traffic in both directions, watch for pedestrians, then make the U-turn.
(2) Glance left and right, and turn when clear.
(3) Honk 3 times, then make the U-turn.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Stop and display the left turn signal or hand signal, check for traffic in both directions, watch for pedestrians, then make the U-turn..

car_questions.question: Which of the following is incorrect regarding left turns at an intersection?
options: (1) You may only turn left when the left-turn signal is on.
(2) You may turn left after straight-going vehicles have passed.
(3) You may rush to turn left as soon as the green light comes on.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) You may rush to turn left as soon as the green light comes on..

car_questions.question: A driver on a road with a traffic island separating fast and slow lanes, while in the fast lane:
options: (1) May turn right.
(2) Must not turn right.
(3) No specific regulation.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Must not turn right..

car_questions.question: On roads with three or more lanes in the same direction, large vehicles must not drive in which lane, except when preparing to turn left?
options: (1) The inner lane.
(2) The middle lane.
(3) The outer lane.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) The inner lane..

car_questions.question: When opposing vehicles turn left and right into a road with two or more lanes:
options: (1) Left-turning vehicles enter the outer lane; right-turning vehicles enter the inner lane.
(2) Right-turning vehicles enter the outer lane; left-turning vehicles enter the inner lane.
(3) Vehicles may drive in any lane.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Right-turning vehicles enter the outer lane; left-turning vehicles enter the inner lane..

car_questions.question: The faster a vehicle travels around a curve, the centrifugal force produced is:
options: (1) Greater.
(2) Smaller.
(3) Unchanged.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Greater..

car_questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, drivers should develop the habit of turning their head to look left and right because:
options: (1) To check for oncoming vehicles.
(2) To watch for blind spots not visible in the rearview mirror.
(3) To avoid glare from the windshield.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) To watch for blind spots not visible in the rearview mirror..

car_questions.question: You are stopped at an intersection and a large vehicle is stopped to your front-left, preparing to turn right. Which of the following is most reasonable?
options: (1) Turning vehicles must yield to straight-going vehicles, so you should pass through as quickly as possible.
(2) If you can see the large vehicle's side mirrors, it means the other driver can definitely see you.
(3) You should avoid approaching its right side and the inner turning zone, yield to the large vehicle to turn right first, and avoid getting caught in its rear wheel offset and blind spots.

car_questions.question: Regarding the sensing limitations of Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC), which of the following objects is most likely to cause the system to misjudge and lead to an accident?
options: (1) A large vehicle traveling steadily ahead in the lane at normal speed.
(2) A construction buffer vehicle completely stationary in a work zone.
(3) A regular heavy motorcycle changing lanes at a steady speed in an adjacent lane.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) A construction buffer vehicle completely stationary in a work zone..

car_questions.question: A large vehicle is traveling inside a tunnel where the vehicle ahead is moving slowly and there are no obvious prohibition signs. Which of the following is correct?
options: (1) Should maintain lane position and keep a safe following distance.
(2) May change lanes and overtake at any time.
(3) May briefly accelerate to overtake, then return to the original lane.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Should maintain lane position and keep a safe following distance..

car_questions.question: When a large vehicle makes a right turn, what is the most correct operation to avoid accidents caused by the inner wheel difference?
options: (1) When turning right, the vehicle should activate the turn signal 30 meters before the intersection, move into the outer lane, right-turn lane, or slow lane, and then make the right turn after reaching the intersection.
(2) Hug the right side and turn directly to shorten the distance.
(3) Accelerate through the intersection to avoid obstructing traffic.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) When turning right, the vehicle should activate the turn signal 30 meters | Year 115 Edition before the intersection, move into the outer lane, right-turn lane, or slow lane, and then make the right turn after reaching the intersection..

car_questions.question: When a large vehicle loaded with cargo passes through a tunnel and encounters traffic congestion, which of the following is most compliant with regulations?
options: (1) You may follow closely behind the vehicle ahead to prevent other vehicles from cutting in.
(2) Maintain a safe following distance, ensure the cargo is secure, and avoid changing lanes arbitrarily.
(3) You may change lanes as appropriate to improve traffic efficiency.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Maintain a safe following distance, ensure the cargo is secure, and avoid changing lanes arbitrarily..

car_questions.question: While driving on a freeway and encountering a vehicle slowing down ahead, how should you respond?
options: (1) Apply emergency brakes immediately.
(2) Maintain a safe following distance and gradually reduce speed.
(3) Change lanes and overtake quickly.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Maintain a safe following distance and gradually reduce speed..

car_questions.question: When intending to change lanes from the outer lane to the middle lane on a multi-lane road, which regulation should the driver follow?
options: (1) First activate the turn signal or use a hand gesture in the direction of the intended lane change.
(2) You may change lanes directly if the distance is sufficient.
(3) Sound the horn as a warning and then change lanes.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) First activate the turn signal or use a hand gesture in the direction of the intended lane change..

car_questions.question: Regarding overtaking and yielding by motor vehicle drivers, which of the following is incorrect?
options: (1) Overtaking is prohibited on curves, steep slopes, narrow bridges, tunnels, and road construction sections.
(2) When overtaking the vehicle ahead, continuously honk the horn and flash the lights to force the vehicle ahead to yield.
(3) Drivers should yield to driving school vehicles, vehicles exclusively for young children, specially-made vehicles for persons with disabilities, and school buses.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) When overtaking the vehicle ahead, continuously honk the horn and flash the lights to force the vehicle ahead to yield..

car_questions.question: A large truck is traveling in the slow lane on a downhill slope in rainy weather with poor visibility. The cargo has a high center of gravity and slightly extends beyond the rear of the vehicle. Ahead is a narrow tunnel exit and an intersection. Nearby pedestrians and motorcyclists are approaching. As the driver, what is the most appropriate course of action?
options: (1) Reduce speed to below the minimum speed limit of the slow lane, maintain lane position, watch for off-tracking, blind spots, give priority to pedestrians, ensure cargo is secure, and be ready to stop at any time.
(2) Maintain the slow lane speed limit and only pay attention to traffic from behind.
(3) Sound the horn to alert surroundings, then pass through the hazardous area quickly to maintain smooth traffic flow.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Reduce speed to below the minimum speed limit of the slow lane, maintain lane position, watch for off-tracking, blind spots, give priority to pedestrians, ensure cargo is secure, and be ready to stop at any time..

car_questions.question: When a driver is following a large vehicle and approaching an upcoming intersection, the traffic signal is about to turn red. What is the most appropriate action?
options: (1) Immediately overtake the vehicle ahead and accelerate through to avoid stopping.
(2) Reduce speed and maintain a safe following distance from the large vehicle ahead.
(3) Follow the large vehicle closely to prevent other vehicles from cutting in.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Reduce speed and maintain a safe following distance from the large vehicle ahead..

car_questions.question: When driving on a freeway and encountering dense fog, heavy smoke, strong winds, heavy rain, nighttime driving, or other special conditions, what safe following distance should be maintained from the vehicle ahead?
options: (1) Maintain the normal safe following distance.
(2) Small vehicles adopt the safe following distance of large vehicles; the safe following distance for large vehicles remains unchanged.
(3) The safe following distance should be increased accordingly and maintained at a distance within which the vehicle can be brought to a complete stop.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) The safe following distance should be increased accordingly and maintained at a distance within which the vehicle can be brought to a complete stop..

car_questions.question: Under normal weather conditions, when a vehicle is traveling on a freeway or expressway at a speed of 90 kilometers per hour, the safe following distance between the vehicle and the one ahead is:
options: (1) 45 meters for large vehicles, 70 meters for small vehicles.
(2) 70 meters for large vehicles, 45 meters for small vehicles.
(3) 70 meters for both large and small vehicles.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) 70 meters for large vehicles, 45 meters for small vehicles..

car_questions.question: Our vehicle has not yet entered the intersection, but an oncoming large vehicle has already entered the intersection and is making a turn. What is the most appropriate action?
options: (1) Turning vehicles must yield to straight-going vehicles, so the large vehicle should give way to us first.
(2) Stop in advance at the stop line and allow it to pass first.
(3) Honk the horn repeatedly to pressure the large vehicle to yield.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Stop in advance at the stop line and allow it to pass first..

car_questions.question: When a small car is following a large vehicle, how should the driver ensure safety?
options: (1) Drive close behind to prepare for overtaking.
(2) Maintain a safe following distance and pay attention to the vehicle ahead.
(3) Accelerate suddenly to overtake.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Maintain a safe following distance and pay attention to the vehicle ahead..

car_questions.question: When a large vehicle is traveling on a narrow road and an oncoming vehicle is a small car, what is the most appropriate action?
options: (1) The large vehicle has the right of way.
(2) Slow down and yield as the situation requires.
(3) Honk to demand the other vehicle to give way.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Slow down and yield as the situation requires..

car_questions.question: How should a driver handle passing on a narrow road when meeting oncoming traffic?
options: (1) Slow down and yield.
(2) Speed up and pass through.
(3) Honk to demand the other driver to give way.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Slow down and yield..

car_questions.question: When a large vehicle arrives at an unsignalized intersection and an oncoming vehicle has already entered the right-of-way zone, what is the most correct action?
options: (1) The larger vehicle may proceed first due to its size.
(2) Slow down and let the other vehicle go first.
(3) No need to slow down, just watch the rear.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Slow down and let the other vehicle go first..

car_questions.question: Which of the following regulations regarding the use of lights is incorrect?
options: (1) When driving through a tunnel, since the tunnel lighting is clear and visibility is good, you may choose not to turn on headlights to save electricity.
(2) Fog lights shall not be used except in rain, fog, or snow.
(3) When driving through mountain areas or special road sections announced by highway authorities or police agencies, tunnels, or vehicular underpasses, lights shall be used as indicated by signs.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) When driving through a tunnel, since the tunnel lighting is clear and visibility is good, you may choose not to turn on headlights to save electricity..

car_questions.question: A large vehicle loaded with sand and gravel is traveling in the slow lane of a road with a lane dividing line, and passes through an unsignalized intersection on a rough road surface. Which of the following best complies with regulations?
options: (1) Cargo must be properly covered and secured, and the driver must follow the slow lane speed limit, reduce speed, and be ready to stop at any time.
(2) As long as the speed limit is not exceeded, cargo shifting is normal and requires no action.
(3) Only the slow lane speed limit of 40 km/h needs to be met; there is no special requirement to cover the cargo.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Cargo must be properly covered and secured, and the driver must follow the slow lane speed limit, reduce speed, and be ready to stop at any time..

car_questions.question: When a vehicle breaks down and cannot be driven, it should be moved to a location that does not obstruct traffic. Regarding the handling of breakdown warning signs before or after the vehicle is moved, which of the following is incorrect?
options: (1) On roads with a speed limit of 40 km/h or below, the sign should be placed on the road surface 100 meters behind the vehicle; placement at an appropriate position in front of the vehicle may be set as needed.

(2) On roads with a speed limit exceeding 40 km/h, the sign should be placed on the road surface between 30 and 100 meters behind the vehicle; placement at an appropriate position in front of the vehicle may be set as needed.
(3) On congested road sections, the sign should be hung on the rear of the vehicle; placement at an appropriate position in front of the vehicle may be set as needed.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) On roads with a speed limit of 40 km/h or below, the sign should be placed on the road surface 100 meters behind the vehicle; placement at an appropriate position in front of the vehicle may be set as needed..

car_questions.question: To avoid accidents with large vehicles, which of the following is the correct concept?
options: (1) Drive as close to large vehicles as possible.
(2) Avoid entering blind spots and maintain a safe following distance.
(3) Pass quickly from the right side.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Avoid entering blind spots and maintain a safe following distance..

car_questions.question: When a car driver stops at an intersection waiting for a signal and is positioned at the front-right of a large vehicle, what is the most likely risk?
options: (1) The large vehicle has a clear line of sight and can clearly identify the small car to its front-right, allowing both to pass safely.

(2) The small car enters the inner wheel difference zone on the side of the large vehicle, making it difficult for the large vehicle driver to notice, creating a risk of being caught and run over by the rear wheels.
(3) The large vehicle starts slowly, so the small car can take the opportunity to pass through the intersection first without any danger.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The small car enters the inner wheel difference zone on the side of the large vehicle, making it difficult for the large vehicle driver to notice, creating a risk of being caught and run over by the rear wheels..

car_questions.question: Regarding a large vehicle parked on the roadside at night when visibility is poor, or when on a road at night with no lighting equipment or insufficient illumination, which of the following handling methods is correct?
options: (1) Only turning on the parking lights is sufficient.
(2) No lighting indication is needed.
(3) Parking lights or reflective markers should be displayed.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Parking lights or reflective markers should be displayed..

car_questions.question: When a large vehicle is traveling on a highway and follows the vehicle ahead too closely, what is the most likely danger?
options: (1) It improves driving efficiency.
(2) It increases vehicle stability.
(3) The shortened reaction time leads to a rear-end collision.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) The shortened reaction time leads to a rear-end collision..

car_questions.question: Which of the following regulations regarding temporarily stopping a vehicle on the roadside is incorrect?
options: (1) At places where temporary stopping is prohibited, you may stop briefly as long as you do not obstruct other vehicles or pedestrians.

(2) Parking is prohibited at the entrances and exits of airports, stations, docks, schools, entertainment venues, exhibition halls, stadiums, markets, or other public places, and in front of fire hydrants.

(3) When parking, the vehicle shall be parked closely along the edge of the road in the direction of traffic flow, with the outer edges of the front and rear tires no more than 60 cm from the curb or road edge.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) At places where temporary stopping is prohibited, you may stop briefly as long as you do not obstruct other vehicles or pedestrians..

car_questions.question: If a small vehicle suddenly cuts in front of a large vehicle and brakes sharply, how should this behavior be classified?
options: (1) It is a legal driving behavior in an emergency situation and does not constitute a violation.
(2) It is a traffic violation and is likely to cause a traffic accident.
(3) Small vehicles have the right of way and only need to be mindful of the following distance.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) It is a traffic violation and is likely to cause a traffic accident..

car_questions.question: Which of the following correctly describes the meaning of a "blind spot" on a large vehicle?
options: (1) The area that the driver can fully see through the rear-view mirrors.
(2) The area that the driver cannot observe either directly or indirectly.
(3) Only the area behind the vehicle that cannot be seen.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The area that the driver cannot observe either directly or indirectly..

car_questions.question: Regarding the blind spots of large vehicles, which of the following is an incorrect concept?
options: (1) Blind spots may exist on the sides of the vehicle.
(2) As long as you can see the driver, you can be sure the driver can see you.
(3) The extent of blind spots may vary depending on the type of vehicle.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) As long as you can see the driver, you can be sure the driver can see you..

options: (1) The outer lane.
(2) The inner lane.
(3) No regulation.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) The outer lane..

car_questions.topic: Driving Precautions (Safe Following Distance, Watching Ahead)
car_questions.question: Accidents during turning are caused by the driver's:
options: (1) Only blind spot negligence.
(2) Only inner wheel difference negligence.
(3) Both blind spot and inner wheel difference negligence.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Both blind spot and inner wheel difference negligence..

car_questions.topic: Driving Precautions (Safe Following Distance, Watching Ahead)
car_questions.question: When a large vehicle passes, it creates a pump-like suction effect. Therefore, when driving alongside or meeting a large vehicle:
options: (1) Grip the steering wheel firmly.
(2) Release the steering wheel.
(3) Move the steering wheel left and right.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Grip the steering wheel firmly..

car_questions.question: The longer a vehicle's wheelbase, the greater the inner-outer wheel difference, meaning the road width needed is:

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Greater..

options: (1) Bumpy road surface.

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Bumpy road surface..

options: (1) Fork road.

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Narrow bridge..

car_questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
options: (1) Bumpy road surface.

(3) Raised road surface.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Raised road surface..

car_questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
options: (1) Steep downhill.

(3) Wharf.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Steep downhill..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcyclist mistakenly enters the national highway, which of the following responses is incorrect?
options: (1) Stop safely on the shoulder and call for assistance
(2) Try to keep up with traffic speed in the outer lane and exit at the next interchange
(3) Drive against traffic along the shoulder to quickly leave the highway.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Drive against traffic along the shoulder to quickly leave the highway..

moto_questions.question: When riding a motorcycle approaching a railway level crossing following another vehicle, you should
options: (1) reduce speed and keep a greater distance from the vehicle ahead
(2) drive as usual
(3) accelerate and overtake from the side.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) reduce speed and keep a greater distance from the vehicle ahead.

moto_questions.question: While driving, upon seeing a railway level crossing sign or road marking, the driver should immediately reduce speed to
options: (1) below 15 km/h
(2) below 30 km/h
(3) no regulation.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) below 15 km/h.

moto_questions.question: If a driver disobeys the instructions of the railway crossing guard, or when the warning bell is ringing, the flashing signal is on, or the barrier is beginning to lower, and still forcibly crosses, in addition to a fine, the driver's license will be suspended for 1 year and the driver must attend a road traffic safety course. If an accident occurs as a result, the penalty is
options: (1) suspension of the driver's license
(2) revocation of the driver's license and prohibition from retaking the test for 1 year
(3) revocation of the driver's license with lifetime prohibition from retaking the test.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) revocation of the driver's license with lifetime prohibition from retaking the test..

moto_questions.question: If a driver disobeys the instructions of the railway crossing guard, or when the warning bell is ringing, the flashing signal is on, or the barrier is beginning to lower, and still forcibly crosses, in addition to a fine,
options: (1) the driver's license will be suspended
(2) the driver must attend a road traffic safety course
(3) all of the above.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) all of the above..

moto_questions.question: If a driver forcibly crosses a railway level crossing and causes an accident, the penalties are
options: (1) a fine
(2) revocation of the driver's license with lifetime prohibition from retaking the test
(3) all of the above.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) all of the above..

moto_questions.question: When a driver overtakes, makes a U-turn, reverses, temporarily stops, or parks on a railway level crossing,
options: (1) a fine of not less than NTD 15,000 and not more than NTD 90,000 shall be imposed, and the driver\'s license shall be suspended;
(2) if an accident occurs as a result, the driver\'s license shall be revoked;
(3) all of the above.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) all of the above..

moto_questions.question: Upon discovering a stalled vehicle on a railway level crossing, one should
options: (1) immediately press the level crossing \"emergency button\";
(2) call the railway emergency contact number 1933;
(3) all of the above.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) all of the above..

moto_questions.question: When a railway level crossing is equipped with barriers or managed by a crossing guard, if the guard has not signaled to stop,
options: (1) you should still look and listen carefully for trains from both directions before crossing;
(2) closely follow the vehicle in front and accelerate to pass;
(3) seize the opportunity and accelerate to pass.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) you should still look and listen carefully for trains from both directions before crossing;.

moto_questions.question: When a railway level crossing is equipped with barriers or managed by a crossing guard, if the barrier has not been lowered,
options: (1) you should seize the time to pass quickly;
(2) closely follow the vehicle in front and accelerate to pass;
(3) you should still look and listen carefully for trains from both directions before crossing.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) you should still look and listen carefully for trains from both directions before crossing..

moto_questions.question: When a railway level crossing is equipped with warning bells and flashing signals, if the bells do not ring and the flashing signals do not activate,
options: (1) you should still look and listen carefully for trains from both directions before crossing;
(2) closely follow the vehicle in front and accelerate to pass;
(3) seize the opportunity and accelerate to pass.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) you should still look and listen carefully for trains from both directions before crossing;.

moto_questions.question: At a railway level crossing,
options: (1) parking is prohibited,
(2) U-turns are prohibited,
(3) all of the above.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) all of the above..

moto_questions.question: When riding a motorcycle across a level crossing, you should:
options: (1) closely follow the vehicle in front,
(2) maintain a proper distance from the vehicle in front,
(3) accelerate to pass through.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) maintain a proper distance from the vehicle in front,.

moto_questions.question: The correct sequence for pressing the red emergency button on the pillar beside the level crossing is:
options: (1) 1. Push, 2. Press, 3. Run,
(2) 1. Run, 2. Push, 3. Press,
(3) 1. Press, 2. Push, 3. Run.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 1. Press, 2. Push, 3. Run..

moto_questions.question: According to the Compulsory Automobile Liability Insurance Act, if the insured fails to purchase compulsory automobile liability insurance and causes an accident, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) Only fined, vehicle license plates are not withheld,
(2) fined and vehicle license plates are withheld until insurance is purchased as required,
(3) only vehicle license plates are withheld, no fine imposed.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Only fined, vehicle license plates are not withheld,.

moto_questions.question: The benefit items stipulated by the Compulsory Automobile Liability Insurance Act include:
options: (1) compensation for injury to life or body,
(2) compensation for property damage to the accident vehicle,
(3) compensation for vehicle theft loss.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) compensation for injury to life or body,.

moto_questions.question: The motorcycle has compulsory automobile liability insurance. The driver, after drinking alcohol, rides the motorcycle carrying a friend home and crashes into a utility pole while taking a curve too fast. Both are injured. Can they apply for insurance compensation?
options: (1) Both can apply
(2) Neither can apply
(3) Only the passenger can apply.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Only the passenger can apply..

moto_questions.question: Rider A and rider B collide in a rear-end accident and are injured. It is determined that A was at fault, and B was not at fault. Can both A and B apply for compulsory automobile liability insurance compensation?
options: (1) Both can apply
(2) Neither can apply
(3) Only B can apply.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Both can apply.

moto_questions.question: Rider A and rider B collide in a rear-end accident and are injured. It is determined that A was riding under the influence of alcohol, and B was not at fault. Can both A and B apply for compulsory automobile liability insurance compensation?
options: (1) Both can apply
(2) Neither can apply
(3) Only B can apply.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Only B can apply..

moto_questions.question: Going out during a typhoon, the vehicle encounters a landslide and debris flow. The driver escapes safely, but the passenger in the same vehicle is seriously injured. Who can claim compensation under compulsory automobile liability insurance?
options: (1) The driver
(2) The passenger
(3) Both of the above.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The passenger.

moto_questions.question: The benefits stipulated by the Compulsory Automobile Liability Insurance Act include
options: (1) Injury medical treatment and disability benefits
(2) Death benefits
(3) Both of the above.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Both of the above..

moto_questions.question: When purchasing a motorcycle, which type of vehicle insurance is required by regulation?
options: (1) Compulsory Automobile Liability Insurance
(2) Compulsory Driver Life Insurance
(3) Compulsory Automobile Damage Insurance
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Compulsory Automobile Liability Insurance.

moto_questions.question: According to regulations, which vehicles are required to have compulsory automobile liability insurance?
options: (1) Bicycles
(2) Motorcycles and automobiles
(3) All of the above
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Motorcycles and automobiles.

moto_questions.question: What are the personal benefits of eco-driving? A. Reducing fuel consumption B. Enhancing traffic safety C. Reducing vehicle maintenance costs D. Reducing stress for drivers and passengers
options: (1) A, B, C, D
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) A, B, C, D.

moto_questions.question: Which of the following driving behaviors can reduce vehicle maintenance costs?
options: (1) Frequent rapid acceleration
(2) Maintaining a constant speed
(3) Frequent sudden braking
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Maintaining a constant speed.

moto_questions.question: What are the main factors causing increased fuel consumption due to under- inflated tires and heavy loads?
options: (1) Increased friction resistance between tires and the road surface
(2) Improper throttle control
(3) Extended warm-up time
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Increased friction resistance between tires and the road surface.

moto_questions.question: When starting a vehicle, which of the following actions is NOT included in eco- driving?\
options: (1) Warm up the engine for 3-5 minutes\
(2) Accelerate slowly, reaching 20 km/h within 5 seconds\
(3) Lightly press the throttle after the engine starts and drive
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Warm up the engine for 3-5 minutes\.

moto_questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a benefit of eco-driving?\
options: (1) Increases travel time\
(2) Reduces carbon dioxide emissions\
(3) Decreases gasoline consumption
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Increases travel time\.

moto_questions.question: When riding a motorcycle on rainy days over road markings, manhole covers, or metal plates, how should you operate the vehicle?\
options: (1) Pass quickly to reduce the time tires stay on slippery surfaces\
(2) Avoid sudden braking or sharp turns on these surfaces; slow down in a straight line to pass\
(3) Road markings and manhole covers are designed to be non-slip, so normal riding is sufficient
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Avoid sudden braking or sharp turns on these surfaces; slow down in a straight line to pass\.

moto_questions.question: When riding a motorcycle through areas with many pedestrians such as schools or hospitals, which riding method is most appropriate?\
options: (1) Pedestrians should pay attention to vehicles; riders may pass at normal speed\
(2) Slow down and proceed cautiously while constantly watching both sides, anticipating pedestrians may suddenly cross\
(3) Honk to alert pedestrians and then pass quickly
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Slow down and proceed cautiously while constantly watching both sides, anticipating pedestrians may suddenly cross\.

moto_questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) Cliff on the right side
(2) Wharf, embankment
(3) Danger
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Wharf, embankment.

moto_questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) Narrow road
(2) Tunnel
(3) Narrow bridge.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Tunnel.

options: (1) Slow down and yield
(2) Turn on the headlights
(3) Signal the turn with the direction indicator.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Turn on the headlights.

moto_questions.question: When the traffic control signal shows a red light:
options: (1) Passage is prohibited
(2) Right-turning vehicles may continue to proceed
(3) Left turns are allowed when traffic conditions permit.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Passage is prohibited.

moto_questions.question: When approaching a railway level crossing on a motorcycle, and the crossing gate is slowly lowering, while many motorcycles ahead accelerate to cross first, what should you do?
options: (1) Immediately follow the vehicles ahead to cross first
(2) Stop and check both sides for danger, then pass under the gate
(3) Stop and wait until the train passes and the gate is raised before crossing.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Stop and wait until the train passes and the gate is raised before crossing..

moto_questions.question: If a driver drives on the sidewalk or fails to yield to pedestrians at a crosswalk as required, causing injury or death, the criminal penalty shall be increased by
options: (1) one time
(2) two times
(3) one half.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) one half..

moto_questions.question: A motorcycle rider running a red light at an intersection controlled by traffic signals, when caught on the spot, will be fined and receive violation points of
options: (1) 1 point
(2) 2 points
(3) 3 points.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 3 points..

moto_questions.question: If a motorcycle driver runs a red light and is caught on the spot, the penalties are
options: (1) a fine of NTD 1,200 to 3,600
(2) suspension of the driving license for 1 month
(3) a fine of NTD 1,800 to 5,400 and 3 demerit points.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) a fine of NTD 1,800 to 5,400 and 3 demerit points..

moto_questions.question: When approaching a pedestrian crossing,
options: (1) you should slow down and proceed with caution; if pedestrians are crossing, you must stop and yield to them first
(2) honk and pass through
(3) accelerate to pass through.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) you should slow down and proceed with caution; if pedestrians are crossing, you must stop and yield to them first.

moto_questions.question: At railroad crossings, intersections, express lanes, and pedestrian crossings,
options: (1) parking is allowed
(2) temporary stopping is allowed
(3) temporary stopping is prohibited.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) temporary stopping is prohibited..

moto_questions.question: On a pedestrian crossing,
options: (1) parking is allowed
(2) temporary stopping is prohibited
(3) no regulations apply.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) temporary stopping is prohibited.

moto_questions.question: When driving to an intersection without signs, markings, or signals designating main or secondary roads,
options: (1) vehicles on multi-lane roads should stop and yield to vehicles on fewer-lane roads
(2) vehicles on fewer-lane roads should stop and yield to vehicles on multi-lane roads
(3) either option is acceptable.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) vehicles on fewer-lane roads should stop and yield to vehicles on multi-lane roads.

moto_questions.question: When approaching an intersection, how many meters before the intersection should you signal with your turn signal or hand gesture when making a left (right) turn?
options: (1) 10 meters
(2) 20 meters
(3) 30 meters.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 30 meters..

moto_questions.question: When approaching a pedestrian crossing without traffic control signals, you should
options: (1) accelerate through
(2) slow down and proceed with caution
(3) no regulation.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) slow down and proceed with caution.

moto_questions.question: Which of the following behaviors is considered a violation when riding a motorcycle?
options: (1) Accelerating quickly to pass before the stop line when the traffic light has turned red near an intersection
(2) Turning right on a red light
(3) Both of the above.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Both of the above..

moto_questions.question: At an intersection without traffic signals or with malfunctioning signals and no traffic personnel directing traffic,
options: (1) vehicles on the minor road should stop and yield to vehicles on the main road
(2) vehicles on the main road should stop and yield to vehicles on the minor road
(3) both are acceptable.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) vehicles on the minor road should stop and yield to vehicles on the main road.

moto_questions.question: When driving a car and pedestrians are crossing at a pedestrian crossing, failing to stop and yield to pedestrians will result in
options: (1) a fine
(2) a 1-month license suspension
(3) a 1-hour traffic safety lecture.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) a fine.

moto_questions.question: To change the color of a motorcycle body, to whom must you apply for a change of registration?
options: (1) The original motorcycle dealer
(2) The motor vehicle supervision authority
(3) The environmental protection agency.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The motor vehicle supervision authority.

moto_questions.question: When encountering pedestrians crossing while driving, which of the following is incorrect?
options: (1) When approaching a pedestrian crossing without traffic control signals, you should slow down and proceed with caution.
(2) When passing a pedestrian crossing and pedestrians are crossing, regardless of whether there are traffic controllers or signal indications, you must stop and allow pedestrians to pass first.
(3) At intersections without marked pedestrian crossings, there is no need to yield to pedestrians first.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) At intersections without marked pedestrian crossings, there is no need to yield to pedestrians first..

moto_questions.question: When passing through an intersection and the traffic control signal is green,
options: (1) you have the right of way and should accelerate to pass through.
(2) you should stop, then start again to pass through.
(3) you should slow down and proceed with caution.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) you should slow down and proceed with caution..

moto_questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a correct behavior for a motorcycle driver passing through an intersection without traffic signals?
options: (1) Slow down when approaching an intersection without traffic signals.
(2) When arriving simultaneously at an intersection without traffic signals, vehicles on the main road have priority.
(3) When arriving simultaneously at an intersection without traffic signals, if both vehicles are going straight, the vehicle on the right yields to the vehicle on the left.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) When arriving simultaneously at an intersection without traffic signals, if both vehicles are going straight, the vehicle on the right yields to the vehicle on the left..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle comes to an intersection with a flashing yellow light,
options: (1) stop first and then pass through
(2) slow down
(3) the light is for reference only.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) slow down.

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle comes to an intersection with a flashing red light,
options: (1) stop first and then passthrough
(2) slow down
(3) the light is for reference only.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) stop first and then passthrough.

moto_questions.question: At an intersection where one side has a flashing yellow light and the other side has a flashing red light,
options: (1) the side with the flashing red light has the right of way
(2) the side with the flashing yellow light has the right of way
(3) the vehicle on the left has the right of way.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) the side with the flashing yellow light has the right of way.

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle rider has already crossed the pedestrian crosswalk at an intersection and the yellow light turns on, they should
options: (1) stop immediately
(2) return to the motorcycle waiting area
(3) continue moving forward.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) continue moving forward..

moto_questions.question: When waiting at a red light on a motorcycle at an intersection, the rider should
options: (1) avoid stopping in front of the fast lane as much as possible
(2) constantly observe the rear traffic through the rearview mirror
(3) all of the above.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) all of the above..

moto_questions.question: When riding a motorcycle through an intersection shared with mass rapid transit vehicles, but the audible and visual signals are malfunctioning and there is no traffic officer directing traffic, the rider should
options: (1) accelerate directly through
(2) stop, look, and listen to ensure no mass rapid transit vehicles are approaching before proceeding
(3) honk the horn to pass.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) stop, look, and listen to ensure no mass rapid transit vehicles are approaching before proceeding.

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle approaches an intersection shared with the Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) system vehicles, and the audible and visual signals are malfunctioning with no traffic personnel directing traffic, the driver should
options: (1) accelerate directly to pass through,
(2) honk the horn while passing,
(3) stop, look, and listen; only pass when no light rail vehicles are approaching from either direction.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) stop, look, and listen; only pass when no light rail vehicles are approaching from either direction..

moto_questions.question: Which of the following driving behaviors is incorrect?
options: (1) It is prohibited to stop in the yellow line area of the light rail track and drivers should pass through as quickly as possible.
(2) When the light rail audible and visual warning signals sound, there is no need to stop, look, and listen; just accelerate quickly to pass.
(3) When passing through an intersection shared with the light rail transit, drivers must obey traffic signals.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) When the light rail audible and visual warning signals sound, there is no need to stop, look, and listen; just accelerate quickly to pass..

moto_questions.question: Regarding micro electric two-wheelers, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) Unauthorized modification of micro electric two-wheelers will result in fines and the vehicle must be restored to its original specifications.
(2) The maximum speed limit for micro electric two-wheelers is 25 km/h; speeding will result in fines.
(3) All of the above.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) All of the above..

moto_questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) Two-way road
(2) Ambulance station
(3) Intersection.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Intersection..

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?
options: (1) Intersection

options: (1) Narrow Road

moto_questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) Steep Uphill

moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Steep Uphill.

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?
options: (1) Pay attention to traffic signals

moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Pay attention to traffic signals.

moto_questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) No pedestrian crossing
(2) Watch out for pedestrians
(3) Watch out for children.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) No pedestrian crossing.

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?
options: (1) Watch out for children

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?
options: (1) Flashing yellow light

moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Traffic control signal.

moto_questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) Double flashing yellow light

moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Special flashing yellow signal.

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?

moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Pedestrian-only signal.

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?
options: (1) Special flashing \"yellow\" signal
(2) Traffic control signal

moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Pedestrian crossing signal..

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?

(3) Road width change line.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Road width change line..

moto_questions.question: The diagonal stripes in the picture indicate:
options: (1) Zebra pedestrian crossing line
(2) Stop line
(3) Road edge line.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Zebra pedestrian crossing line.

moto_questions.question: The horizontal solid white line in the picture indicates:
options: (1) No passing line
(2) Stop line
(3) Pedestrian crosswalk line.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Stop line.

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?
options: (1) Vehicles coming from the front must stop

moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Vehicles coming from the front and rear must stop, vehicles from the left and right may proceed..

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?
options: (1) All vehicles must stop
(2) Vehicles coming from the front and rear must stop, vehicles from the left and right may proceed
(3) Vehicles coming from the front must stop.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) All vehicles must stop.

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?
options: (1) Vehicles coming from the right are turning left
(2) Vehicles coming from the right are proceeding straight
(3) Vehicles coming from the left are proceeding straight.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Vehicles coming from the right are turning left.

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?
options: (1) Vehicles coming from the right must stop
(2) Vehicles coming from the right are turning left
(3) Vehicles coming from the right are proceeding straight.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Vehicles coming from the right must stop.

moto_questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) The vehicle coming from the right is making a left turn.
(2) The vehicle coming from the left is proceeding straight.
(3) The vehicle coming from the right is proceeding straight.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The vehicle coming from the left is proceeding straight..

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?
options: (1) The vehicle coming from the left is making a left turn.
(2) The vehicle coming from the right is proceeding straight.
(3) The vehicle coming from the left is stopping.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) The vehicle coming from the left is making a left turn..

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?
options: (1) The vehicle ahead is stopping.
(2) Vehicles ahead and behind stop, vehicles on the left and right proceed.
(3) All vehicles must stop.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) The vehicle ahead is stopping..

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?
options: (1) The vehicle coming from the right is stopping.
(2) The vehicle coming from the left is proceeding.
(3) The vehicle coming from the right is proceeding straight.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) The vehicle coming from the right is proceeding straight..

moto_questions.question: Regarding the violation criteria for running a red light, which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: (1) If a vehicle crosses the stop line after the red light and is sufficient to obstruct traffic in other directions, it constitutes running a red light.
(2) If a vehicle's front wheel crosses the stop line after the red light, it already constitutes running a red light; the entire vehicle body does not need to cross.
(3) If a vehicle crosses the stop line after the red light but does not actually obstruct traffic in other directions, it does not constitute running a red light.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) If a vehicle's front wheel crosses the stop line after the red light, it already constitutes running a red light; the entire vehicle body does not need to cross..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle is waiting at an intersection and the traffic signal turns red, the rider then crosses the stop line to make a U-turn. Regarding the determination of whether this behavior constitutes a violation, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) Crossing the stop line with any part of the vehicle during a red light constitutes running a red light, and this determination is not affected by any subsequent U-turn or turning maneuver.

(2) A U-turn is a maneuver to turn back onto the original roadway and does not actually pass through the intersection into opposing traffic; therefore, it should be penalized as an illegal U-turn rather than running a red light.
(3) If the intersection is equipped with a "No U-turn" sign, the rider shall be penalized for violating the sign; if there is no such sign, it does not constitute a violation.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Crossing the stop line with any part of the vehicle during a red light constitutes running a red light, and this determination is not affected by any subsequent U-turn or turning maneuver..

moto_questions.question: Which of the following actions does NOT constitute running a red light?
options: (1) After the traffic signal turns red, the vehicle crosses the stop line and obstructs the movement of pedestrians or vehicles from other directions.
(2) The vehicle passes the stop line before the signal turns red, but due to heavy oncoming traffic, it does not turn into the connecting roadway until the signal for all directions turns red.
(3) After the traffic signal turns red, the vehicle crosses the stop line and makes a U-turn into the connecting roadway.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The vehicle passes the stop line before the signal turns red, but due to heavy oncoming traffic, it does not turn into the connecting roadway until the signal for all directions turns red..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle is approaching a signal change and is unable to stop in time in accordance with the traffic signal, causing the front wheel to cross the stop line while the main body of the motorcycle remains behind the stop line, which of the following statements regarding the determination of a traffic violation is correct?
options: (1) If only the front wheel crosses the stop line while the main body of the motorcycle does not cross the stop line, it is considered a violation of pavement marking instructions.
(2) If any part of the vehicle crosses the stop line during a red light, it constitutes running a red light, regardless of the extent of the crossing.
(3) Since the rider has stopped in time and did not continue moving forward, this indicates compliance with the traffic signal and does not constitute any violation.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) If only the front wheel crosses the stop line while the main body of the motorcycle does not cross the stop line, it is considered a violation of pavement marking instructions..

moto_questions.question: When a vehicle proceeds into an intersection while facing a green signal despite traffic congestion in the straight-ahead or turning lane, and after the signal changes it is unable to clear the intersection, thereby obstructing the passage of other vehicles, which of the following statements regarding the determination of a traffic violation is correct?
options: (1) No violation has been committed.
(2) Running a red light.
(3) The signal was green when the vehicle entered the intersection; subsequent stoppage due to congestion is a non- attributable cause and therefore does not constitute a violation.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) The signal was green when the vehicle entered the intersection; subsequent stoppage due to congestion is a non- attributable cause and therefore does not constitute a violation..

moto_questions.question: When a vehicle passes the stop line before the red light is illuminated, but due only to cross traffic obstruction or the large size of the intersection, remains waiting within the intersection after the light turns red, and then, when traffic from other directions decreases or a gap appears, proceeds to cross the intersection into the connecting roadway, how should this be determined?
options: (1) Running a red light.
(2) This is considered a special circumstance and is not regarded as running a red light.
(3) Considered a failure to comply with pavement marking instructions.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) This is considered a special circumstance and is not regarded as running a red light..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle rider, after the red light is illuminated, crosses the stop line and thereby obstructs the passage of vehicles or pedestrians from other directions, how should this be determined?
options: (1) Not regarded as running a red light.
(2) Running a red light.
(3) Subject only to a fine, with no demerit points recorded.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Running a red light..

moto_questions.question: Regarding the definition of the area of a level (at-grade) intersection, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) The intersection area shall, in all cases, be defined as the area formed by connecting the stop lines of all approaching roads.
(2) The intersection area shall be defined based on the controlled area covered by traffic signals or traffic signs.

(3) Where stop lines are marked, the intersection area shall be the roadway area covered after the stop lines are drawn; where no stop lines are marked, the intersection area shall be the roadway area covered after drawing an imaginary line extending from the edges of the roadway or sidewalk, plus 5 meters outward.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Where stop lines are marked, the intersection area shall be the roadway area covered after the stop lines are drawn; where no stop lines are marked, the intersection area shall be the roadway area covered after drawing an imaginary line extending from the edges of the roadway or sidewalk, plus 5 meters outward..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle approaches an unsignalized intersection, how should the riding speed be adjusted?
options: (1) Accelerate and pass through the intersection.
(2) Slow down and proceed with caution.
(3) Maintain the original speed.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Slow down and proceed with caution..

moto_questions.question: When approaching an intersection, if the distant traffic control signal has turned yellow and the motorcycle has not yet crossed the stop line, how should the rider proceed?
options: (1) To save time, accelerate and continue riding in order to avoid waiting unnecessarily for the red light.
(2) Maintain the original speed and pass through the intersection so as not to affect following traffic.
(3) Appropriately slow down and stop before the stop line to wait for the red light.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Appropriately slow down and stop before the stop line to wait for the red light..

moto_questions.question: If a driver runs a red light in order to save time and is cited on the spot, what penalty shall be imposed in accordance with the law?
options: (1) A fine only.
(2) A fine and mandatory attendance at a 3-hour traffic safety education course.
(3) A fine and the recording of 3 demerit points.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) A fine and the recording of 3 demerit points..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle rider runs a red light at an intersection controlled by traffic signals in order to rush through, what amount of fine shall be imposed in accordance with the regulations?
options: (1) A fine of NT\$1,800 to NT\$5,400
(2) A fine of NT\$1,200 to NT\$3,600
(3) A fine of NT\$900 to NT\$1,800
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) A fine of NT\$1,800 to NT\$5,400.

moto_questions.question: If a driver makes a right turn on a red light at an intersection controlled by traffic signals, what penalty shall be imposed?
options: (1) A fine of NT$600 to NT$1,800
(2) A fine of NT$1,200 to NT$2,400
(3) A fine of NT$1,200 to NT$1,800
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) A fine of NT$600 to NT$1,800.

moto_questions.question: When two motorcycles approach an intersection from different directions at the same time, where the intersection is not equipped with any traffic signals or stop (yield) signs/markings, and the number of approach lanes in their directions of travel is the same, and both motorcycles are proceeding straight ahead, which of the following statements regarding right-of-way is correct?
options: (1) The vehicle on the right shall yield and allow the vehicle on the left to proceed first.
(2) The vehicle on the left shall yield and allow the vehicle on the right to proceed first.
(3) The vehicle traveling at the higher speed shall have the right- of-way.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The vehicle on the left shall yield and allow the vehicle on the right to proceed first..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle rider approaches an intersection equipped with a pedestrian crosswalk and observes pedestrians crossing the roadway, which of the following actions is correct?
options: (1) As long as a sufficient distance is maintained, slowly pass through the gaps in front of or behind the pedestrians.
(2) Approach the pedestrians and sound the horn to signal them to hurry across.
(3) Stop and yield, allowing the pedestrians to pass first.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Stop and yield, allowing the pedestrians to pass first..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle reaches an intersection and encounters a green traffic signal, how should it proceed through the intersection?
options: (1) A green light confers absolute right-of-way; accelerate and pass through.
(2) Reduce speed and proceed with caution.
(3) A green light confers absolute right-of-way; maintain the original speed and pass through.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Reduce speed and proceed with caution..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle approaches an intersection, which of the following statements regarding safe passage through the intersection is correct?
options: (1) When the signal is green, the motorcycle may proceed directly without further observation of traffic conditions at the intersection.
(2) The rider should pay attention to traffic conditions ahead and on both sides, and proceed in accordance with traffic signals, signs, and pavement markings.
(3) Following the vehicle ahead while maintaining a safe distance is sufficient to pass through the intersection safely.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The rider should pay attention to traffic conditions ahead and on both sides, and proceed in accordance with traffic signals, signs, and pavement markings..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle reaches an intersection marked with a "motorcycle and slow vehicle waiting area" and encounters a red light, which of the following statements regarding the stopping position is correct?
options: (1) The motorcycle and slow vehicle waiting area and the left-turn waiting area are both for motorcycles; either may be used depending on available space.
(2) The rider shall stop within the motorcycle and slow vehicle waiting area as indicated by pavement markings, or behind the stop line, and shall not stop in the left-turn waiting area.
(3) If there is available space in the left-turn waiting area, the rider may enter it directly to shorten the waiting time.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The rider shall stop within the motorcycle and slow vehicle waiting area as indicated by pavement markings, or behind the stop line, and shall not stop in the left-turn waiting area..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle passes through a pedestrian crosswalk and encounters a pedestrian who is illegally crossing against the red light, which of the following statements regarding the rider's proper action is correct?
options: (1) Since the pedestrian is in violation, the rider has the right-of-way when proceeding according to the signal and may sound the horn as a warning and proceed directly.
(2) Even though the rider should slow down when the pedestrian is in violation, if a collision occurs, the responsibility for the accident shall rest with the violating pedestrian.
(3) Although the pedestrian is in violation and subject to penalty, the rider shall still exercise caution and stop to yield, allowing the pedestrian to pass first.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Although the pedestrian is in violation and subject to penalty, the rider shall still exercise caution and stop to yield, allowing the pedestrian to pass first..

moto_questions.question: When a vehicle approaches an unsignalized roundabout, which of the following statements about right-of-way priority is correct?
options: (1) Follow the rule of \"yield to the vehicle on the right\" --- vehicles entering the roundabout from the right have priority.
(2) Yield to vehicles already traveling inside the roundabout, then enter in order.
(3) Vehicles coming from wider roads or roads with heavier traffic have priority to enter the roundabout.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Yield to vehicles already traveling inside the roundabout, then enter in order..

moto_questions.question: When encountering a flashing red traffic signal while driving, which of the following statements about its meaning and the driver's required action is correct?
options: (1) A flashing red light means warning --- vehicles should slow down, approach carefully, and proceed after ensuring safety.
(2) A flashing red light is the same as \"stop and go\" --- vehicles must come to a complete stop and may proceed only after confirming it is safe.
(3) A flashing red light indicates a minor road ahead --- vehicles may proceed after confirming there is no traffic on the main road.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) A flashing red light is the same as \"stop and go\" --- vehicles must come to a complete stop and may proceed only after confirming it is safe..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle approaches an intersection and the green light is on, which of the following statements about how to pass through the intersection is more correct?
options: (1) A green light means permission to proceed --- after confirming there are no vehicles blocking ahead, you may pass directly.
(2) When the light is green, pedestrians are not allowed to cross according to regulations, so drivers may proceed normally according to the signal.
(3) Even when the light is green, drivers should still pay attention to the intersection --- if pedestrians are crossing, they should yield and let them go first.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Even when the light is green, drivers should still pay attention to the intersection --- if pedestrians are crossing, they should yield and let them go first..

moto_questions.question: At an intersection, when traffic police hand signals and traffic lights are both present but give conflicting instructions, which one should be followed?
options: (1) Traffic lights.
(2) Traffic signs or road markings.
(3) Traffic police officer's hand signals.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Traffic police officer's hand signals..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle rider approaches a signalized intersection and sees a red light, where should they stop?
options: (1) Stop before the pedestrian crossing line.
(2) Do not pass the stop line or enter the intersection.
(3) Stop and wait in the middle of the intersection.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Do not pass the stop line or enter the intersection..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle approaches a pedestrian crossing without traffic signals, which of the following statements about the rider's proper behavior is correct?
options: (1) If the rider visually confirms there are no pedestrians on the crosswalk, they may maintain their current speed and pass through.
(2) Regardless of whether there are pedestrians on the crosswalk, the rider should slow down and approach cautiously.
(3) If pedestrians have not yet stepped onto the crosswalk, vehicles have right of way.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Regardless of whether there are pedestrians on the crosswalk, the rider should slow down and approach cautiously..

moto_questions.question: When a car turns, the longer the wheelbase, the greater the difference between the inner and outer wheel paths, meaning the required road width is\
options: (1) Smaller\
(2) Larger\
(3) Unchanged
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Larger\.

moto_questions.question: After completing their missions, the driving speed of fire trucks, ambulances, and police vehicles should be
options: (1) unrestricted
(3) in accordance with the road speed limit.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) in accordance with the road speed limit..
